title: CORSAIR MP600 Mini 2TB M.2 NVMe PCIe x4 Gen4 SSD – M.2 2230 $327 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: CORSAIR MP600 Mini 2TB M.2 NVMe PCIe x4 Gen4 SSD – M.2 2230 $327 Delivered @ Amazon AU

[evanssm2jp] Bought a used Asus Z13 395+ 1tb/32gb model at auction which arrived yesterday for just over $2k not noticing it took a 2230! Was looking just yesterday and cheapest was over $400 - this should do the trick. Cheers..
[evanssm2jp] Just ebay… been looking for a while and it came up at the right price…just wish it was the higher ram model!
[evanssm2jp] Link? Not that I trust Aliexpress for storage / way too many fakes and support for returns is woeful!
[ozbargainhunter400] Getting a refund for a new born child is easier than a aliexpress return
[Some Random Guy] I had an electronic device which I paid about $15 for. It arrived faulty (very easy to prove as it had LEDs that wouldn't turn on).
Getting a refund involved shipping it back and getting the full refund either same day or a couple days down the track.
[abowen] I've refunded & returned several items. Not as easy as Amazon, but good enough.
[BROKENKEYBOARD] I think this is it https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005010024519793.html ~300
[srshk] Would this be good for the Steam Machine?
[BROKENKEYBOARD] @srshk: I guess but I'd rather the Corsair one because of warranty.
[Franc-T] Not woeful, but problematic (recently returned a mini PC that was dodgy specced without issue).
That said, I would get this one
[ATangk] Remember when 2Tb 2230 SSD's were $130 on aliexpress? Pepperidge Farm remembers.
[Fuzor] Yes but probably not for a big name like Corsair
[ATangk] Uhh… It was Western Digital SN740. Just a small company.. around 100 times larger than Corsair?
[dan0909] Aliexpress is not for this sort of stuff. Reliability, longevity, warranty are AliExpress' enemies.
[jinkerjinx] I got a WD SN740 2TB off Ali for $145 a year ago.
Verified genuine by WD (serial number check).
Hasn't missed a beat.
I figured if the HDD lasted the 90 day return they were offering, it would prob be alright.
Ali refunds for DOA or dead soon after, have always been super easy for me.
(but yeah, there's basically no warranty long term)
[Notbigdeal] Wow, such a good deal like once in a lifetime !
[ronie1993] Sold out while in the cart. Damn. Looked like a great deal!
[Pone] Bought one for $398 last month for my ASUS PX13 thought it was a good price, now it's AWESOME price!
Great performance for TLC model and not heating up like the Sandisk counterpart :)
[BusMan247] Crazy prices .. but not in an amazing way. More like you’ve been kicked in the balls you might as well swallow
